additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Hope you are doing great.
As per reported issue by an end customer, we found that the AC outlet (Outlet 2) is not operational due to RCD
and/or MCB AC Charging tripped.
'RCD_FB1_or_MCB_FC5_AC_Charging
One of the AC fuses is constantly tripping, it seems like there is also something wrong with either of these Fuses.
I recommend you to take spare parts to site for FC5 and FB1.
To fix the issue for AC outlet we need to check RCD and MCB connections.
